rules.title: NVIDIA driver is not visible to the current environment
rules.summary: PyTorch was built with CUDA support, but nvidia-smi is unavailable.
suggestions: Confirm the NVIDIA driver is installed on the host.
If running in Docker, start the container with NVIDIA Container Toolkit GPU access.

rules.title: PyTorch is not installed
rules.summary: PyTorch-specific CUDA and NCCL checks were skipped.

evidence.label: torch
evidence.literal: not found in the current Python environment

suggestions: Install the PyTorch build appropriate for your platform if this environment needs PyTorch.

rules.title: CPU-only PyTorch build detected on an NVIDIA GPU machine
rules.summary: The host has an NVIDIA GPU, but this PyTorch build has no CUDA runtime.
suggestions: Install a CUDA-enabled PyTorch wheel matching your deployment requirements.

rules.title: PyTorch has CUDA support but cannot use CUDA
rules.summary: The installed PyTorch build includes a CUDA runtime, but CUDA initialization is unavailable.
suggestions: Check whether the host driver supports the CUDA runtime used by PyTorch.
In containers, verify GPU devices and driver libraries are mounted into the container.

rules.title: NVIDIA driver does not support the CUDA runtime used by PyTorch
rules.summary: The maximum CUDA version reported by nvidia-smi is older than torch.version.cuda.
suggestions: Upgrade the NVIDIA driver, or install a PyTorch build using an older supported CUDA runtime.

rules.title: System CUDA toolkit differs from PyTorch CUDA runtime
rules.summary: This is often valid because PyTorch wheels can ship their own CUDA runtime, but source builds and CUDA extensions may use the system toolkit.
suggestions: Do not change versions solely because of this warning.
If a CUDA extension fails to build/load, verify which toolkit and ABI it was compiled against.

rules.title: NCCL is unavailable in a multi-GPU PyTorch environment
rules.summary: Distributed GPU workloads usually require a working NCCL backend.
suggestions: Verify that your PyTorch build includes NCCL support.
Run a small torch.distributed NCCL smoke test before launching a large job.
